name: Sehlabathebe National Park
story: Sehlabathebe National Park is located in the Maloti Mountains in Qacha's Nek District, Lesotho, at an average elevation of some 2,400 metres above sea level. Established on 8 May 1969, the park features grasslands, cliffs, waterfalls, and rock dwellings.
matters: The park is part of the Maloti-Drakensberg World Heritage Site and its larger ecosystem functions provide freshwater to Lesotho, South Africa, and Namibia. Endangered species such as the Cape vulture and bearded vulture find a home here.
